stories.title: Nepal-China flood rescue on hold as lake breaks banks
stories.summary: The death toll from the Himalayan flash floods has climbed to 469, with more than 1,000 still missing. Meanwhile, authorities warn an overflowing lake formed by debris could trigger a second wave of flooding.

stories.title: Top Iranian diplomat says returning to talks with US possible
stories.summary: Abbas Araghchi called on the US administration to engage in respectful dialogue, recognize Iran’s rights, and honor its commitments
article_sentences: Iran may return to negotiations with the US, but Washington must first stop applying pressure, Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated.
"Putting diplomacy back on track isn't impossible.
It hinges on US understanding of one simple fact: pressure doesn't work," the top diplomat wrote in a post on his X page.
Araghchi called on the US administration to engage in respectful dialogue, recognize Iran’s rights, and honor its commitments.
Earlier, US President Donald Trump emphasized that the Washington administration is not currently interested in holding consultations or meetings with Iranian officials.
